name: b2_dma_q_ref-r1-6403f77f2
purpose: ot_hgi_b2_dma_q (B2 cluster DMA unit, one hardened unit for the four clusters, qid strap; FRONT 0 VR2 1 KVW 1) FIRST physical probe + its first bench. Synthesis (pre_route_gate --remote ot-epyc1tb, 2026-10-13): 255,646 cells, 54,435 flops, std 36,503 um2 + 3 x ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2 21,275 um2 -> 760 x 162 um at util 0.47, M5 leaf cap, clock spine (54k sinks > 15k: --cts evidence still owed). Faces: W = dispatch record bus dma_rec/dma_ret + clk/rst/qid (716 b), S = HBM lanes of stack qid toward the collective/kport (k_* 603 b + r_* 624 b), N = the local VM slice (vmq 338, vmr 274, vr2q 513, vr2r 8,257, wl 8,960, wl_done 32). CUT: N 18,374 b / 36,940 tracks (760 um, M3 36 nm + M5 48 nm) = 0.50; S 1,227 / 36,940 = 0.03; W 716 / 3,375 (162 um, M4 48 nm) = 0.21; E empty. N is the binding face and 8,960 of its bits are wl = the mover's ONE 280-b lane expanded one-hot to 32 lanes inside the unit (FRONT 0): exporting {lane 280} and expanding in the VM slice would cut N to 9,694 b (0.26 at 760 um, or a 370 um face at 0.54). Bench (this commit): tb_hgi_b2_dma_q, bench-own HBM/VM models, 4 qid straps, 266 records, checked=118197 PASS; MUT_B2=1 FAIL. Throughput at full rate: LOAD 1.066 cycles / 32 B sector (30.0 B/cycle), STORE posted 0.556 (57.5 B/cycle), STORE drained by FENCE 1.347 (23.8 B/cycle).
